{{Quote|Personally, I don't care why you've come&mdash;as long as you destroy the Flesh Raiders.|Moorint|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
'''Moorint''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as the [[Scout Chief]] for the [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A skilled [[Scout/Legends|tracker]], Moorint served as the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Sumari]] during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] with the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of Tython. When Sumari [[Death/Legends|died]] from illness, he served Sumari's daughter, [[Ranna Tao'Ven]], faithfully until approached by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]], who was controlling the Flesh Raiders, with an offer of peace. After capturing the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and delivering the [[Human/Legends|Human]] to Morr's clutches as part of their agreement, Moorint and the villagers failed in their attempt to capture [[Hero of Tython|Din's apprentice]] but were forgiven by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Moorint and his people continued to live on Tython alongside the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] erupted into [[Galactic War|renewed war]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|For months, we begged the Council to send help! And no matter how many you kill, the Flesh Raider numbers keep growing. You can't win.|Moorint|<ref name="Dark Temptations">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Dark Temptations|Tython}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Moorint was one of many who joined the [[Pilgrims]], a religious group founded by [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Pilgrims">{{TORcite|type=codex|Twi'lek Pilgrims}}</ref> When the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] rulers began to discriminate against the group for their adherence to the Pilgrim religion,<ref name="The Thousand Steps">{{TORcite|type=general|The Thousand Steps|Tython}}</ref> Kolovish led the Pilgrims to visit other Twi'lek colonies, and Moorint joined the Pilgrims during this [[Time/Legends|time]] sometime before the Pilgrims discovered the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the homeworld of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> However, as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had only recently rediscovered the world the [[3651 BBY|year before]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] refused the group settlement rights, but the Pilgrims refused to depart.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> In the [[Tythos Ridge]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] near the location where the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|new Jedi Temple]] was being built in [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]], the group established the village of [[Kalikori village|Kalikori]] in the small valley where they had arrived.<ref name="Kalikori">{{TORcite|type=codex|Kalikori Village}}</ref>

[[File:Moorint_talking.png|thumb|left|260px|Scout Chief Moorint]]
There, the Pilgrims spent the next<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> seven<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] fending off attacks by the [[Flesh Raider]]s, the vicious natives of the planet, and Moorint became the village's [[Scout Chief]]. His [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] would gather information on the natives' movements,<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> working with the Pilgrim militia [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Bashenn]] to prepare the village's defenses accordingly,<ref name="PilgrimsQuest">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Pilgrims|Tython}}</ref> and Moorint quickly gained experience and knowledge of the Flesh Raiders' tactics and movements. Kolovish retired at some point during the Cold War, and Moorint served her successor, [[Sumari]], as the Matriarch's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] alongside Sumari's daughter, [[Ranna Tao'Ven]]. The Jedi Order was forbidden by their [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]] to actively aid the villagers out of respect for the Senate's wishes, fostering a deep resentment of the Order amongst the villagers.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

Around the year [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Flesh Raiders began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|move in greater numbers]] against both the Jedi Order and the villagers, and Moorint's scouts heard sounds of conflict from the nearby [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region. There, they witnessed a Flesh Raider invasion force be turned back by Jedi after their commander, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]], was killed by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi apprentice]], and the [[Gnarls cave|passageway]] they were using to enter the Gnarls was sealed.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref> Not long afterward, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] sent the apprentice&mdash;now his official [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]&mdash;to meet with the Matriarch and learn what the villagers knew of the Flesh Raiders.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

{{GameLS}}
However, Sumari had recently fallen ill, and her daughter took over more and more of her [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] duties to help the woman cope. The Matriarch was forced to retire early into the conversation, causing Moorint and Tao'Ven to take over and explain Sumari's offer: if the apprentice would deal with the Flesh Raiders' weapons, the villagers would give the Jedi their knowledge of the natives' movements. Tao'Ven wished for the Padawan to recover the weapons for the villagers, but Moorint believed that it would be more effective to sabotage the weaponry and inflict casualties amongst the enemy. The apprentice ventured into the cave system known as the [[Upper Hollows]] in the Tythos Ridge to retrieve the weapons and managed to rescue an [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] named [[T7-O1]] in the process.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> In exchange, Moorint revealed that his scouts had witnessed a great deal of activity near the ancient Jedi temple [[Kaleth]].<ref name="Enemy Force">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Enemy Force|Tython}}</ref>

Using the Scout Chief's information, the apprentice [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|investigated]] and battled [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Flesh Raiders.<ref name="Enemy Force" /> As the Jedi Order learned that Din's former student, [[Bengel Morr]], had become a Dark Jedi and was leading the natives, it began to make war upon the Flesh Raiders with help from Moorint's scouts. Using information gathered by the scouts to locate one of the Flesh Raiders' [[Flesh Raider command base|command bases]], a team of Jedi Masters and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|attacked]] the compound after Din's apprentice [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|disabled]] the base's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. However, even after the Padawan [[Skirmish in the Kalikori village fields|saved]] the village from a surprise attack,<ref name="The Face of the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Face of the Enemy|Tython}}</ref> Moorint and the other villagers remained resentful of the Jedi and leapt at a chance to save themselves at the expense of the Order when Morr approached them with an offer: give him Din, and they would be safe from harm.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />

[[File:Betrayal.png|thumb|right|250px|The villagers attempt to kill the Padawan.]]
Broadcasting a fake [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]], the villagers lured Din and his student back to the village, where Din was subdued by Morr's forces. However, Morr changed the terms of their agreement and demanded the life of Din's new apprentice as well, forcing Moorint and two other villagers named [[Eseni]] and [[Saylew]] to try and kill the Padawan when the young Jedi arrived. The newly appointed Matriarch Tao'Ven,<ref name="Dark Temptations" /> whose mother had [[Death/Legends|passed away]] before Morr had approached the village,<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> attempted to stop Moorint, Eseni, and Saylew from killing the apprentice, giving the Jedi [[Time/Legends|time]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] the villagers with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to depart in peace. The Padawan went on to [[Battle of the Forge|defeat]] Morr and rescue Din, ending the conflict with the Flesh Raiders by depriving the natives of their leader. At the apprentice's behest, the Order did not seek any disagreement with the village over its betrayal and instead began to work together more closely with Moorint and the other Pilgrims. With the restrictions placed by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] loosened, the Jedi and the Pilgrims coexisted peacefully on Tython as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] descended into [[Galactic War|renewed war]].<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We need to strike fear into the Flesh Raiders. Sabotage their weapons. Fix it so they blow up in their ugly faces&hellip;|Moorint|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-skinned Twi'lek male with gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Moorint was fiercely protective of his people and loyal to the Matriarch. However, years of fighting the Flesh Raiders gave him a deep hatred of the natives, and he believed that it was better to strike against one's enemy than to strengthen oneself.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> Resentment of the Jedi drove Moorint and the villagers to sacrifice Orgus Din and his apprentice, but the Scout Chief did not enjoy betraying the Jedi who had aided his people.<ref name="Dark Temptations" /> He was also a skilled scout and tracker, achieving the post of Scout Chief in his village and commanding the Pilgrims' scouts at the behest of the Matriarch.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Moorint wore brown clothing with dull armor pieces attached, and wielded a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in combat.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sabotage would thin the Flesh Raider numbers and eliminate their technological advantage.|Moorint proposes the dark side option in the quest "High-Tech Savages"|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
Moorint first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Prologue of the Jedi Knight storyline on Tython, during several of the cutscenes in various missions. In the mission "High-Tech Savages," Moorint suggests that the player destroy the weapons cache, a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] option, while Tao'Ven asks the player to recover the weapons for the villagers (the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] option).<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> Moorint can later be killed in "Dark Temptations" along with Eseni and Saylew for dark side points, while the light side option is to Force-persuade the villagers to leave in peace.<ref name="Dark Temptations" /> This article assumes that the player chooses only the moral light side options as a Republic Jedi Knight character,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> and therefore assumes that Moorint and the others survive.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />
